senses.gloss:
म्लुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Mixed, intermixed, inlaid, set.
 E. म्लुच् to go, aff. क्त ।

म्लुच्(उ)म्लुचु r. 1st cl. (म्लोचति) To go, to move. With अभि and नि pre-
fixed.
 1. To go down.
 2. To set as the sun.
म्लुञ्च् (उ) म्लुञ्चु r. 1st cl. (म्लुञ्चति) To go, to move; also read म्लुन्च् ।
